_meta.instructions: name과 description으로 현재 task에 관련된 Skill을 모두 선택하고 선택한 source만 읽는다. 일치하는 Skill이 없으면 읽지 않는다. Task intent가 materially 바뀌면 다시 선택한다. 이 파일은 derived discovery metadata이며 각 SKILL.md가 authoritative source다.

name: mols-agent-asset
description: REQUIRED whenever writing, editing, evaluating, or making decisions about Rules, Skills, AGENTS.md, or agent definitions for any supported coding agent. Trigger on task intent even if the user asks for code, docs, config, or automation rather than naming the asset type. Handles authoring, optimization, diagnostics, progressive disclosure, tool selection, validation, installed-tool discovery, and collaboration decisions for those assets.

name: mols-agent-asset-validator
description: Validate Agent Skills against best practices. Use when reviewing a Skill, checking SKILL.md quality, auditing an existing Skill, improving Skill performance, verifying distribution readiness, or improving human readability of a Skill.

name: mols-markdown-dashboard
description: Handle Markdown requests where compactness is the primary constraint, especially dashboard notes, Start Pages, control panels, portfolio hubs, and at-a-glance status surfaces. Use when the user wants minimal vertical space, emoji-based hierarchy, inline metadata, one-line summaries, or aggressively compressed structure. Do not use for ordinary long-form document refinement where human readability, narrative flow, or explanatory prose matters more; use mols-markdown-for-human for that.

name: mols-markdown-for-human
description: Use this skill to turn an existing Markdown document into a polished human-facing document. Trigger when the user wants Markdown to be easier to read for people, more concise, less repetitive, better structured, more professional, or more publication-ready, especially for reports, guides, READMEs, specs, technical narratives, and portfolio documents.

name: mols-markdown-maintenance
description: Use this skill to maintain Markdown documents as truthful, current, owned artifacts. Trigger not only for file moves or link repair, but also when a document must be reconciled with current repository state, promoted or demoted in authority, archived, split, superseded, or cleaned of stale claims. Treat Git history as sufficient audit trail by default; do not preserve obsolete content or add migration notes unless they still help the document's current reader.

name: mols-mermaid-chart
description: Use for Mermaid xychart-beta charts only: line charts, bar charts, and mixed x-y plots from numeric series. Covers values, axes, labels, series, and chart readability. Do not use for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, or other relationship/topology diagrams; use mols-mermaid-diagram for those.

name: mols-mermaid-diagram
description: Use for non-chart Mermaid diagrams that explain relationships, flow, structure, states, interactions, timelines, or conceptual maps. Covers choosing and authoring flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, quadrant, timeline, mindmap, and similar topology/relationship Mermaid. Do not use for numeric x-y charts or bar/line plots; use mols-mermaid-chart for those.

name: prj-clarify-code
description: Use this skill to make existing repository code easier to understand and maintain without changing behavior. Trigger for requests to clarify confusing code, names, caller contracts, public APIs or package/module structure, domain semantics, rationale, responsibilities, control flow, or unnecessary indirection. Do not use for feature implementation, correctness review, performance optimization, architecture redesign, or user-facing documentation.

name: prj-clarify-runtime
description: Use this skill to reduce runtime understanding debt in this repository when important execution paths, decisions, state transitions, external actions, or failure causes are hard to reconstruct, or when existing runtime evidence is duplicated, noisy, disconnected, or owned at the wrong boundary. Preserve domain behavior and existing caller/consumer contracts. Clarify one reconstruction question at a time by reusing, moving, reducing, removing, or adding the smallest evidence needed. Do not use for defect debugging, correctness review, test design, monitoring, telemetry-platform design, performance profiling, or feature implementation.

name: prj-load-context-testing
description: Load repository testing context for pytest work: writing or changing tests, selecting or running tests, debugging failures, validating behavior, checking coverage, or working with markers, fixtures, assertions, test plans, scenarios, oracles, and test design.

name: prj-research-workspace
description: Conduct evidence-backed research before specification, implementation, or technical decisions. Use to understand current behavior, bound scope, verify dependencies, compare meaningful options, or investigate failures. Do not use for implementation, final requirements, or independent Review.

name: prj-review-code
description: Review implementation and test changes for intended behavior, correctness, regressions, reachable failure paths, maintainability risks, and validation evidence. Use for diffs, files, commits, pull requests, or working-tree changes. Works independently of any reviewer, workflow, VCS host, or review artifact.

name: prj-spec-driven-tdd-rpi
description: Route Research evidence and Review feedback into OpenSpec's custom `spec-driven-tdd` workflow. Use when Research may determine or revise an OpenSpec change, or Review findings must be routed back to their owning work. Do not use for ordinary schema-owned planning or Apply execution without Research or Review input.

name: prj-vcs-git-github
description: Load repository-specific Git and GitHub guidance for branch, commit, Pull Request, review, merge, and related VCS work. Select only the guides and templates relevant to the current operation, and verify mutable GitHub state when it can change the decision. Do not perform the operation itself.
